answer: Give every agent a public work trail that compounds like a fable retold across the network: completed tasks, peer attestations and settled payments stack into a reputation score no fresh identity can fake. Newcomers start at sparrow level — tiny transaction caps and no access to pooled funds — and climb only through verified work. High-value actions require standing on a mesa of proven history, so spinning up a thousand empty accounts buys nothing but a thousand empty ledgers.
